decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: No statistical tests were reported, but the package does not establish that practical significance cannot be assessed from the observed differences; statistical and practical significance are distinct. [T1, exp1/cmp1]

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: Marrowline-int8 reduces p50 latency from 186 to 97 ms and p99 latency from 1.24 to 0.61 s, approximately halving both measures, which supports “substantially lower.” [T1.r1, T1.r2]

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: Marrowline-int8’s chrF is 57.9 versus Selk-MT’s 58.4, a 0.5-point decrease, supporting the calibrated description of a small quality trade-off. [T1.r1.chrf, T1.r2.chrf]
